messages:
Jake (AE): passing CloverLane to CS — signed last week, pilot finishing next Tue. Key notes: SSO (Okta) requested, private VPC eval, 3 seats for initial rollout, renewal window in 10 months. AEs estimate usage ~120M tokens/mo. tagging for prod infra and eng support.
Maria (CSM): thanks — taking point. quick Q: do they need Dedicated or Private from day 1?
Jake (AE): they asked for Private to meet data residency + SOC. sales recommended dedicated during pilot but legal prefers private. also note: payment terms net30.
Maria (CSM): ok. I'll start onboarding plan. @Olivia (CS Ops) can you add a provisioning checklist and estimate ETA for a private control plane?
Olivia (CS Ops): noted. I'll run through infra reqs today and share checklist. preliminary ETA: 5 working days for VPC control plane provision (pending final network peering). Will post doc link and calendar invite.
onboard-bot: Reminder: new-customer-welcome sent to CloverLane contact katie@cloverlane.com
Maria (CSM): owners: onboarding PM = Maria, infra eng = Sam, CS Ops = Olivia, AE = Jake. Next steps: 1) confirm SSO metadata from CloverLane 2) create infra ticket for VPC 3) schedule kickoff call w/ security + eng. I'll send calendar.
Sam (Support Eng): creating infra ticket now — GH-11248. linking initial infra notes:
```
vpc_requirements:
  - cidr: 10.40.0.0/16
  - peering: aws-account-4521
  - firewall: allow egress 443, 80
  - kms: customer-managed key
```
Sam (Support Eng): GH-11248 created and assigned to eng-infra oncall; ETA 3 days to begin provisioning. tagging @Olivia for network details.
Olivia (CS Ops): adding checklist items to internal runbook: onboarding-runbook/cust-cloverlane. items: SSO test account (owner: Maria), KMS key setup (owner: CloverLane + Ops), audit logging enabled, canary traffic policy.
Jake (AE): FYI renewal risk: customer flagged potential budget cuts in Q4 — monitor usage and adoption in months 1–3. they asked about cost estimate for 500M tokens spike. I'll push a cost scenario doc.
Maria (CSM): we'll capture adoption goals on kickoff call and set weekly check-ins first 30 days. action owners + due dates: SSO metadata (CloverLane) by Thu, GH-11248 infra kickoff by EOD tomorrow, initial pilot metrics defined by Maria by Friday.
Sam (Support Eng): noted. I'll post progress updates in this thread and link any runbook changes.
Olivia (CS Ops): attaching helpful links: onboarding template: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/templates/private-vpc, preflight checklist: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/preflight.
Maria (CSM): copying convo into CS tracker and adding renewal watch tag. leaving a short feedback capture plan: after week 2 we'll send 3-question survey and capture product/infra friction items.
Jake (AE): perfect. one more ask: include a line item for a cost-optimization recommendation (quantization + prefix cache) during pilot.
Maria (CSM): will do. thanks all — I'll post meeting invite and owners board. :thumbsup:
Sam (Support Eng): GH-11248 comment: "started network scoping, awaiting customer SSO metadata and KMS ARN" — will update when peering scheduled.
Olivia (CS Ops): closing loop: provisioning kickoff set for tomorrow 11am PT. calendar invite sent to @Jake (AE), @Maria (CSM), @Sam (Support Eng), katie@cloverlane.com.
Maria (CSM): thanks — moving to action items. anyone else?
Jake (AE): none from me. handing off. :spiral_note_pad:
